title.zh: Crypto exchange recovery rules split NES holders into winners and losers after $286M exploit fallout
title.en: Crypto exchange recovery rules split NES holders into winners and losers after $286M exploit fallout

current_state.zh: Binance Alpha and Kraken have restored NES trading with venue-specific recovery rules after an August 24 token-contract exploit, splitting holders into winners and losers while leaving self-custody holders without a universal migration route.
current_state.en: Binance Alpha and Kraken have restored NES trading with venue-specific recovery rules after an August 24 token-contract exploit, splitting holders into winners and losers while leaving self-custody holders without a universal migration route.
